description: This script facilitates manual validation of VBSS (Vendor Bridge Station Switching) features within a wireless networking context. It performs operations such as validating station MAC address input, manipulating wireless station keys and sequence counters via SSH commands to remote devices, and managing AP and station modes for testing purposes. It includes functions for reversing and incrementing keys, retrieving and setting wireless keys, and controlling station and AP state to simulate and test VBSS move procedures.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses a hexadecimal key string by folding into two-character parts, reversing their order, and concatenating.

methods.name: inc_key
methods.description: Increments a hexadecimal key string by an arbitrary value, properly handling byte order.
